description: Language-neutral unit data for the converter: densities per kind of liquid and the mass totals of official ingredient lists. The unit vocabulary, the free-text unit mapping, the rounding grid, piece weights and name conventions are language-specific and live in the locale packs (knowledge/locales/<locale>/units.json).

densities.note: g per ml. The corpus gives no densities; these are standard values the ingredient analysis used.

massTotals.note: Sum of g over the ingredient list, not the bowl content.
